scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/identity && tsc -p packages/events && tsc -p packages/notifications && tsc -p packages/storage && tsc -p packages/webhooks
scripts.test: npm run check:generated && npm run build && npm run check:example && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:example: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node examples/storage-upload/index.ts
